content.text:
**Finding: MFN — compliant (preferred position).**

- No provision anywhere in the agreement requires Ono to give Array terms no less favourable than those extended to any third party, and there is no right-to-match or best-offer mechanic burdening Ono.
- The only MFN-style term, Section 9.3(b), benefits Ono: Array cannot require Ono to order directly from a Subcontractor unless that Subcontractor will supply Ono on terms as favourable as those it has extended to Array. Per the playbook, a Vendor-granted MFN is welcome and is not redlined.
- Other "favorable" hits (withholding-tax rate, safety benefit/risk language) are unrelated to MFN.

No redline proposed.
